responsibility: Exposes the shared core, workspace and qualification services to agents as MCP tools with generated input and output schemas, structured content, bounded context and previews; dispatches the catalogued agent tools for workspaces, compositions, diagrams and qualification runs against per-session handles; serves the guidance, workspace, record, diagram and schema resources; and returns concise orientation instructions at initialization.
owns: Tool registration with compact advertised schemas, the schema resources that hold the full contract, schema-conforming structured content with a text fallback, and protocol compatibility results.
Session routing: each call that uses stored state names a workspace handle of its own session, and no call can change another session's workspace.
Asynchronous dispatch: long work such as a qualification run or a render runs outside the request, so it never blocks status, cancellation, other workspaces or browser events.
boundary: No alternative mutation, readiness or acceptance policy.
Record text and retrieved documents are returned as data and never grant tool authority.
An advertised schema is a compact view; every call is validated against the full contract before anything runs.
A tool takes no shell command, connection string, URL or executable path; execution identities come from trusted local configuration.
Initialization instructions orient an agent and authorize nothing; the client decides how to present them.

provides.name: tools
provides.concurrency: A persistent mutation requires the expected base revision; two agents editing one prior revision cannot both succeed.

provides.name: loom.workspace
provides.concurrency: Inspect, initialize, open, status and close by action; a handle belongs to the session that opened it, and close settles its owned work before releasing it.

provides.name: loom.federation
provides.concurrency: Inspect, plan, apply, check and publish by action; apply and publish write only against the expected revision vector, and an incomplete journaled change blocks further composed writes until recovery.

provides.name: loom.diagram
provides.concurrency: Renders from one snapshot within the rendering budget; the terminal rendering runs outside the request.

provides.name: loom.qualify
provides.concurrency: Start returns a run handle after preflight and the run continues outside the request; status pages its progress; cancel is idempotent and completes only once the run's processes and resources have settled.

provides.name: instructions
provides.concurrency: One concise orientation text returned at initialization, the same for every session under one contract digest and at most mcp.instructionsBudget UTF-8 bytes of the operation catalogue.

provides.name: guideResources
provides.concurrency: The guidance at loom://guide/engineering, loom://guide/workflow and loom://guide/capabilities, the same for every session and fixed by the contract digest each names.

provides.name: workspaceStatusResource
provides.concurrency: loom://workspaces/{workspaceId}/status, readable only by the session that holds the handle.

provides.name: recordResources
provides.concurrency: loom://workspaces/{workspaceId}/records/{kind}/{id}, one whole record at the model revision it names, readable only by the session that holds the handle.

provides.name: diagramResources
provides.concurrency: loom://workspaces/{workspaceId}/diagrams/{diagramId}, one diagram for the source vector it was built from, readable only by the session that holds the handle.

provides.name: schemaResources
provides.concurrency: The full contract of one definition at loom://schema/<Definition>, immutable for the contract digest it names; an unknown definition is a resource-not-found protocol error.
